name: Egyptian Chamomile
description: Premium grade whole and sifted chamomile flowers, harvested at peak potency with exceptional essential oil retention. Known for vibrant golden yellow color. Perfect for herbal teas, cosmetics, and pharmaceutical applications.

name: Organic Peppermint Leaves
description: Premium organic peppermint leaves (Mentha piperita), shade-dried to preserve aroma and menthol content. Ideal for specialty teas, essential oil extraction, and culinary applications.

name: Red Hibiscus Flowers
description: Deep crimson whole calyces of Hibiscus sabdariffa. Intensely tart and vibrant, perfect for herbal beverages, food colorants, and traditional wellness preparations.

name: Spearmint Leaves
description: Carefully selected and sifted whole spearmint leaves with a milder, sweeter profile than peppermint. Excellent for herbal blends, confectionery, and beverages.

name: Premium Fennel Seeds
description: Grade-A fennel seeds (Foeniculum vulgare) with distinctive anise aroma. Used in traditional medicine, culinary spice blends, and natural digestive preparations.

name: Natural Licorice Root
description: Pure dried licorice roots (Glycyrrhiza glabra) in premium quality sticks and slices. Widely used in traditional herbal medicine, confectionery, and pharmaceutical formulations.

name: Dried Basil Leaves
description: Premium dried basil (Ocimum basilicum) with strong aromatic properties. Perfect for culinary use, herbal teas, and natural flavoring applications.

name: Organic Lemon Balm
description: Fresh-dried lemon balm (Melissa officinalis) with bright citrus aroma. Ideal for herbal infusions, aromatherapy, and wellness beverages.

name: Sage Leaves
description: Premium dried sage (Salvia officinalis) with robust earthy aroma. Widely used in culinary preparations, herbal medicine, and natural preservative applications.

name: Premium Coriander Seeds
description: Grade-A coriander seeds (Coriandrum sativum) with warm, citrusy aroma. Essential for culinary spice blends, herbal formulations, and essential oil production.

name: Dried Marjoram Herb
description: Premium dried marjoram (Origanum majorana) with sweet, floral notes. Ideal for gourmet culinary applications, herbal tea blends, and natural wellness products.

name: Dried Ginger Root
description: Premium dried ginger (Zingiber officinale) with intense pungent aroma. Sourced from top-growing regions, perfect for culinary, medicinal, and functional beverage applications.

name: Organic Calendula Flowers
description: Certified organic calendula (Calendula officinalis) whole flowers. Bright orange-gold petals prized in cosmetic formulations, herbal salves, and natural skincare products.

name: Dried Rosemary Leaves
description: Premium dried rosemary (Salvia rosmarinus) with strong pine-like aroma. Essential for culinary seasoning, natural preservative systems, and herbal wellness products.

name: Natural Chamomile Tea Bags
description: Premium chamomile flower tea bags made from whole, unbroken flower heads. Individually wrapped for freshness. Perfect for retail, hospitality, and wellness brands.
